summary: Task 8.4 cannot be satisfied via `make run` because the dev-build gate (D5) short-circuits any non-/Applications/, non-/Caskroom/ bundle path.
detail: `make run` launches from .build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug/, so isInstalledBuild() returns false and check() exits before the network call regardless of the pinned CFBundleShortVersionString. Verified end-to-end by copying the built binary to /tmp/Caskroom/hootty/0.0.1/Hootty.app/Contents/MacOS/Hootty and launching from there: lastCheckedAt and lastSeenVersion=v0.2.0 persisted, and an outbound TCP socket to 140.82.114.5:443 (GitHub) appeared. Future verification tasks for gated features should either document this /Caskroom/ path-substring trick or add an env-var escape hatch (deferred per D5 alternatives) so `make run` can exercise the check directly.

summary: Tasks 8.4-8.6 mix code-path verification with visual UI confirmation; an automated agent can only do the former.
detail: Side effects (UserDefaults writes, network sockets) are observable from the shell via `defaults read` and `lsof`. Pill rendering and the 'Copied' label flip cannot be confirmed without a human eyeball or screenshot tooling. The pill wiring was inspected at ContentView.swift:271-285 and the click handler calls UpdateChecker.copyBrewCommand() which writes the literal `brew upgrade --cask hootty` to NSPasteboard.general — but no automated test exercises the pasteboard side. Future blueprints could split visual-only checks into a separate phase or call them out explicitly.
